description: Ensure UTF-8 is, or isn't, the system code page, which takes effect at the next restart

exitCodes.2: A code page couldn't be written to the registry, or utf8 isn't true or false
exitCodes.3: Windows gave no default code page for the system locale

utf8.description: true for UTF-8 (65001) as the ANSI, OEM and Mac code pages; false for the code pages the system locale defaults to. From get: whether the registry holds 65001 for all three

pendingAnsiCodePage.description: The ANSI code page (ACP) in the registry, which Windows uses from the next restart; null if it isn't a number

pendingOemCodePage.description: The OEM code page (OEMCP) in the registry, which Windows uses from the next restart; null if it isn't a number

pendingMacCodePage.description: The Mac code page (MACCP) in the registry, which Windows uses from the next restart; null if it isn't a number

activeAnsiCodePage.description: The ANSI code page the running system uses (GetACP)

activeOemCodePage.description: The OEM code page the running system uses (GetOEMCP)

_restartRequired.description: Set while a restart is needed for the code pages to take effect: get, while the active ones aren't the registry's; test and set, while the active ones aren't the wanted ones. DSC collects it into executionInformation.restartRequired

_inDesiredState.description: From test: whether the registry holds the wanted code pages and the running system already uses them; values waiting for a restart are not
